title: Looping Configuration Constants
description: Schema for project-wide configuration constants used by the Looping live performance system

features.description: One switch per bespoke subsystem (general-release audit §7b), read once by the bridge (interface/bridge/utils/features.js) and sent to every client as /bridge/features. Only an explicit true turns a subsystem on: false or a missing entry is off. `_`-prefixed keys are documentation.

totalmix.description: RME TotalMix monitor link (ADR-423): the bridge's mixer ports and startup bootstrap, and the status-strip monitor bars.

maxUtilityPatch.description: The owner's standalone Max patch (owner/Max Patches/Max Utility 1.0.maxpat): opened by npm run dev and npm run ipad, and the System view's Move Knob switch.

expressionPedal.description: The expression pedal and its toe switch (the midiPedals wah CCs) and the Pedal view's Wah button. Off, the surface claims neither CC. The foot switch is a user setting, not this switch.

menubar.description: The owner's macOS menu-bar app (owner/menubar): built and launched by npm run dev and npm run ipad only while on.

axHelper.description: The Looping AX Helper (ADR-439): the bridge dials it, and the UI draws Reverse, Group and the held pad's similar-sample swap, only while on.

paths.description: File system paths for project resources

abletonApp.description: The Live app to open, when it is on this Mac. Otherwise scripts/open-live.js opens the Live whose version names the preferences folder Live wrote last.

browserBlocker.description: The owner's browser-blocker script, another repo's, started by npm run ipad. Unset, nothing is started.

userLibraryBase.description: Absolute filesystem root of Ableton's User Library. DeviceLoadComponent strips this prefix from incoming preset paths and descends the browser's user_library tree by the remaining segments.

instrumentsBase.description: The instrument library's root; sidebarRoot sits inside it. Paths recorded before the Places (<instrumentsBase>/<Vendor>/<Type>/…) and Sidebar paths are both read from it for a category (interface/src/lib/utils/presetPath.ts).

sidebarRoot.description: The browser's library: one folder per rail button, each a Place in Live's sidebar (Looping's documentation/browser-places.plan.md). scripts/generate-places-catalog.ts reads it; without it the browser has no Places.

abletonPacksBase.description: Absolute filesystem root of Ableton's installed Packs. /api/sample-peaks and /api/similar-samples allow sample files under it (interface/src/lib/server/sampleRoots.ts).

placesRoots.description: Mapping of Ableton sidebar Place display names to their filesystem roots. DeviceLoadComponent uses this to resolve preset paths that live outside User Library by descending browser.user_folders.

waveformMaxBytes.description: Maximum on-disk size (bytes) for files the /api/sample-peaks route will decode via the full-decode Path B (compressed: mp3/flac/ogg/m4a). Path A (streaming WAV/AIFF) ignores this cap. Files routed through Path B above this return 413. Sized for the decoded-memory footprint of the largest legitimate Simpler sample; default 75 MB.

waveformStreamingEnabled.description: Feature flag for /api/sample-peaks Path A (streaming PCM peaks for WAV/AIFF/AIFC). When true, uniform-PCM files are processed by reading <=1MB at a time and computing peaks without holding full PCM in memory — decouples cost from file size, eliminates the cap for these formats. When false, all files take the full-decode Path B (legacy behavior). Roll back by flipping to false; Path B remains intact during the rollout window.

liveDatabaseDir.description: Live's own file-index folder (a leading ~/ is the home directory). /api/similar-samples reads the newest Live-files-<schema>.db in it, read-only, for the similarity vectors Live's indexer stores (ADR-440). Its contents are never written; the open is SQLite's readOnly, not immutable=1, so it does create the -shm/-wal sidecars a WAL reader needs.

liveRecordingsDir.description: Live's temporary folder, where it makes a Temp Project for every unsaved set (a leading ~/ is the home directory). The bridge hands the newest one to Vamp-Recorder.amxd before each capture (interface/bridge/handlers/captureRecorder.js). Live's default is ~/Music/Ableton/Live Recordings.

maxPatchMinDelayAfterLiveMs.description: Minimum gap between launching Ableton Live and opening the Max Utility patch, so Max initializes against a running Live

reporting.description: OSC monitoring report interval in ms

meterBatching.description: Meter update batching interval in ms

trackReorderDebounceMs.description: Track reorder debounce delay in ms

serverPresence.description: Bridge → surface liveness heartbeat cadence + grace window

heartbeatIntervalMs.description: How often the bridge announces liveness to the surface

graceWindowMs.description: Max heartbeat age before the surface considers the server gone

pythonSurface.description: Python Control Surface — m4l-to-python migration Gate 1 onward

loopingRecorder.description: Vamp-Recorder.amxd OSC capture device — bidirectional control + state feedback and its hello

backendScope.description: Per-backend overrides of the default prefix-based routing. Addresses listed here are routed to the named backend instead of falling through to the default. See Looping's documentation/archive/m4l-to-python/05-migration-plan.md §1.

pythonSurface.description: OSC addresses routed to the Python Control Surface. Each entry is either an exact address (e.g. '/live/test') or a prefix glob ending in '*' (e.g. '/looping/v2/*'). Gate 5 introduced the glob form.

loopingRecorder.description: OSC addresses routed to the Vamp-Recorder.amxd capture device. Same glob/exact rules as pythonSurface.

port.description: WebSocket server port (avoid 8080 - causes RSV1 errors)

maxRecentMessages.description: Maximum recent messages to keep for debugging

sweepLoadMargin.description: How close to each end of the 0-127 expression-pedal range counts as reaching that end, for the sweep-to-load gesture. 0 demands literal 0 and 127.

midiWheels.description: The MidiWheels MIDI effect (2026-09-25): the on-screen pitch/mod wheels (MidiWheelsComponent) and, on MIDI tracks, the expression pedal (WahPedalComponent) drive its parameters. Absent, the wheels do nothing and MIDI tracks get the wah.

sweepLoadMargin.description: How close to each end of the 0-127 expression-pedal range counts as reaching that end, for the sweep-to-load gesture. 0 demands literal 0 and 127.

midiPedals.description: MIDI CC map for pedals plugged into the Looping control surface's own MIDI input port (ADR-422)

channel.description: MIDI channel the pedal transmits on (1-16); 0 means listen on all 16 channels

footSwitchCC.description: Seeds the foot switch on a machine with no saved setting (logs/foot-switch.json). Absent, and nothing saved, there is no foot switch; the System view's Learn sets one.

maxFolderDepth.description: Cap folder nesting at this many levels in every Place; deeper folders roll their presets up and de-dupe by name. A Place's Samples folder is exempt.

places.description: Per-Place tuning, keyed by the Place's sidebar name: maxFolderDepth (overrides the global value), flattenFolders (paths '<Place>/<folder>', ADR-408), keepNestingFolders (breadcrumb label chains, ADR-420) and role (the track role a load records; null for none).

gestures.description: Touch gesture thresholds shared by the interface and the Move pad script

momentaryHoldMs.description: A press released under this is a tap (latch); at or over it, a hold (momentary)

axHelper.description: Looping AX Helper (ADR-439): the one process that drives Live's UI through macOS Accessibility. Built and registered by `npm run install-ax-helper`; Accessibility trust is granted to that app bundle once, in System Settings.

appName.description: The .app bundle's name under ~/Applications; the trusted identity TCC records

bundleId.description: The bundle identifier the LaunchAgent and the Accessibility grant are keyed on

socketPath.description: Owner-only Unix socket the bridge dials (mode 0600 in a 0700 directory) -- whoever can connect can press anything in Live, so never a TCP port

messagingTimeoutS.description: Per-request AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout. The cold first kit swap takes ~5 s and the 6 s default returns -25204 although Live completes it

requestTimeoutMs.description: The bridge's own ceiling on one helper reply

statusIntervalMs.description: How often the bridge polls the helper's `status` verb for the presence channel

localPort.description: Local port for receiving OSC messages

remotePort.description: Remote port for sending OSC messages
